authoring.method: Assistant-authored synthetic core workers and requests; deterministic templated background expansion. No separate model-provider calls during data construction or evaluation, and no production mailbox/history.
authoring.reviewer: Implementation assistant; no independent human reviewer
authoring.split: Entire task families are disjoint; five development and fifteen evaluation families. Author knows both splits.
authoring.measurement_policy: Frozen before first ranker measurement; no ranker tuning on this dataset. No production-accuracy or promotion claim.
authoring.provenance_clarification: Authorship wording clarified after the first run began; no worker, query, judgment, generation input or catalog fingerprint changed. The initial run retains its original manifest snapshot.

generation.scope_rule: Every additional worker has a different named project. Every answerable base request identifies its protected base project.
